title: Alwaai Hayat
description: Alwaai Hayat, which translates directly to "Awareness is Life," is an Egyptian guidance and wellness organization providing dedicated life coaching, emotional counseling, and mindful family support. Founded to support individuals navigating profound personal transitions, newly formed marriages, and early parenthood, the initiative provides accessible workshops and one-on-one sessions designed to cultivate deep emotional resilience, inner grounding, and lasting relational harmony.

Seeking emotional guidance can often feel intimidating, vulnerable, or socially stigmatized in traditional communities. Alwaai Hayat was established as a safe, compassionate haven that demystifies personal therapy, offering practical strategies to help individuals and couples overcome disorientation, cultivate genuine self-awareness, rebuild emotional clarity, and nurture healthy, enduring relationships throughout all life stages with dignity, warmth, and lasting inner peace.
direction: The identity is built with the same intention an NGO would carry: simple, multicolored, and strong. Nothing about it needed to be complicated, the message itself, awareness and renewal, had to come through at a glance.

The logo is a modern depiction of a lotus flower, a symbol that in ancient Egypt represented rebirth and renewal, life beginning again after recreation. Drawn the way it is here, the lotus doubles as a rising sun, a more universal signal for a new day. The open, multi lined leaves carry a second meaning too, they read like open arms, welcoming and reassuring, which is exactly the feeling the brand wants someone to have the moment they consider reaching out for help.
